description: Free. Returns a ready-to-sign Hyperliquid order for your own wallet or API wallet: entry (limit-first post-only at the best price, with a market fallback, or market), optional protective stop, and leverage action, all carrying AgentZ's 5 bps builder code. Also checks whether the wallet has approved the builder fee. AgentZ never holds your keys.

leverage.description: Leverage for the leverage action, default 2.

market.description: Hyperliquid market, e.g. BTC, ETH or xyz:TSLA.

reduce_only.description: True to only reduce an existing position.

stop_pct.description: Optional protective stop distance in percent, e.g. 4.

wallet.description: Optional. Your wallet, to check builder-fee approval.

name: build_order
title: Build an unsigned order
